escalations.title: Vitest UI Server: Arbitrary File Read + Remote Code Execution
escalations.exploit_scenario: Developer runs vitest --ui on shared CI machine; attacker with port access reads arbitrary files or executes code via localhost:51204

escalations.title: Protobufjs: Arbitrary Code Execution via Unsafe Deserialization
escalations.exploit_scenario: Attacker sends crafted protobuf telemetry message triggering code execution in portal/Backend

escalations.title: proxy-addr: IPv4-Mapped IPv6 Spoofing → Authentication Bypass
escalations.exploit_scenario: Attacker sends X-Forwarded-For: ::ffff:127.0.0.1 to bypass IP-based access controls (rate limiting, admin allow-list)

escalations.title: Tinypool: Prototype Pollution → Remote Code Execution
escalations.exploit_scenario: Crafted vitest config exploits prototype pollution in worker options, executes attacker code in Node worker

escalations.title: React Router: Open Redirect via Protocol-Relative URLs
escalations.exploit_scenario: Attacker crafts link with //evil.com path; react-router navigates user to external site (phishing vector)
escalations.fix: npm update react-router-dom (ensure >=6.22.3) in both frontend projects

backlog.title: Handlebars: Arbitrary File Read + Expression Injection via Jest Chain
backlog.exploit_scenario: Crafted test template exploits Handlebars expression injection or file read via babel-jest during build
backlog.fix: npm install --save-dev jest@latest in Source/Backend (major version bump to >=30.5.2)

backlog.title: dev-workflow-platform.md: 69 FRs entirely unimplemented; spec describes a different product
backlog.exploit_scenario: Future agent reads Specifications/ as source of truth, builds SQLite FR management system on top of in-memory work item platform
backlog.fix: Add STATUS: SUPERSEDED banner to Specifications/dev-workflow-platform.md

backlog.title: Traceability enforcer checks only 1/8 plans; 117+ FRs in other plans go unchecked
backlog.exploit_scenario: Agent runs enforcer, gets TRACEABILITY PASSED, ships code that ignores 21 FRs from dev-cycle-traceability or 15 FRs from duplicate-deprecated-status
backlog.fix: Add --all-plans flag to traceability-enforcer.py; iterate all Plans/*/requirements.md

backlog.title: Dashboard activity response missing pagination envelope (page/limit/total/totalPages)
backlog.exploit_scenario: Consumer calls GET /api/dashboard/activity?page=2&limit=10 and receives 10 items with no indication that 50 more exist — silent data truncation
backlog.fix: Return { data, page, limit, total: allEntries.length, totalPages } from getActivity(). Update DashboardActivityResponse shared type.

backlog.title: eslint-disable react-hooks/exhaustive-deps without documentation in 2 frontend files
backlog.exploit_scenario: useWorkItems.ts hook becomes stale after prop changes; component renders data from previous render cycle (silent wrong data)
backlog.fix: Fix underlying dependency exhaustion or add eslint-disable-next-line with explanation comment

backlog.title: gRPC certificate validation bypass + DoS via OpenTelemetry chain
backlog.exploit_scenario: Attacker sends malformed gRPC request causing portal/Backend crash (DoS) or bypasses certificate validation
backlog.note: DEP-006 is P2 high-severity; auth bypass component also reviewed by TheGuardians (escalated via DEP-002)

backlog.title: Jest chain: 35+ high CVEs in Source/Backend test toolchain (babel-jest, braces, jest-message-util)
backlog.exploit_scenario: Test infrastructure compromise via micromatch regex DoS or jest-message-util arbitrary code execution during CI
backlog.fix: npm install --save-dev jest@latest (major version bump to >=30.5.2)
